item.title: Teens, 14 and 16, charged with murder of Maryland man
item.description: Two teenage boys are facing murder charges for allegedly shooting and killing a man in Somerset County, Maryland, in January, officials announced on Friday. Teen boys charged with murderThe Maryland State Police charged the two boys, aged 14 and 16, with first and second-degree murder, robbery and other charges for the Jan. 26 shooting.Police arrested the 14-year-old on Feb. 10 in Princess Anne. item.title: DC Public Health to begin daily testing of Potomac, Anacostia rivers for E. coli
item.description: Beginning on Monday, the D.C. Department of Health will be conducting daily tests for E. coli in the Potomac and Anacostia rivers. It comes more than five weeks after the Potomac interceptor collapse sent millions of gallons of sewage into the river.The testing will also coincide with an important safety advisory being lifted.Director of the D.C. item.description: One person was injured Friday night after a gas leak led to a home explosion in Calverton, Prince George's County Fire and Rescue says.Officials say the explosion happened in the area of Powder Mill Road and Cherry Hill Road. According to the Prince George's County Fire Department, a gas leak led to an explosion that brought down power lines. item.title: Evacuation orders lifted for all homes following home explosion in Centreville
item.description: A big development came on Friday in the aftermath of a house explosion and days-long neighborhood evacuation in Centreville. All of the remaining homes in the neighborhood that were evacuated have now been deemed safe, so residents can return. Until Friday morning, 19 homes in this neighborhood were still under an evacuation order, but that order has now been lifted. item.title: DC, Maryland, Virginia leaders react, MPD increases vigilance after US strikes on Iran
item.description: Police in Washington, D.C., say there are no known threats after U.S. military strikes on Iran. Lawmakers in Maryland and Virginia are calling for a War Powers vote.

item.title: Pilot killed after small plane crashes in woods of Hollywood, Maryland
item.description: First responders located a downed aircraft in a wooded area of Hollywood, Maryland, after multiple 911 calls reporting a possible crash.

item.title: Driver dead after fiery rest stop crash in Virginia
